agentGuide: Jira Cloud, base path /rest/api/3. Me: GET /rest/api/3/myself. Search: GET /rest/api/3/search/jql?jql=<JQL>&maxResults=20&fields=summary,status,assignee,priority,updated (JQL: project = ABC AND status != Done ORDER BY updated DESC; assignee = currentUser()). One issue: GET /rest/api/3/issue/<KEY>?fields=summary,description,status,comment; create: POST /rest/api/3/issue {"fields": {"project": {"key": "ABC"}, "summary": "...", "issuetype": {"name": "Task"}, "description": {"type": "doc", "version": 1, "content": [{"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "..."}]}]}}} (descriptions and comments are Atlassian Document Format). Comment: POST /rest/api/3/issue/<KEY>/comment {"body": <ADF>}; transition: GET /rest/api/3/issue/<KEY>/transitions then POST ... {"transition": {"id": "31"}}; assign: PUT /rest/api/3/issue/<KEY>/assignee {"accountId": "..."}. Projects: GET /rest/api/3/project/search; boards and sprints: GET /rest/agile/1.0/board, GET /rest/agile/1.0/board/<id>/sprint?state=active. The credentials are set by Allkin.
